title: Media Arts - Animation
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: Media Arts – Animation - Certificate of Achievement (CA)
outcomes: Students will be able to communicate core visual art concepts in oral and written assignments.
Students will demonstrate the ability to use critical thinking skills when designing and implementing independent skill-based projects.
Students will demonstrate informational and technological competence as applied to visual art concepts
Students will be able to apply visual arts principles to the development of lifelong personal growth recognizing the complexity of social, cultural, and international diversity.

notes: Total of 18 units is stated both in the Program Requirements sentence and as 'Total Units 18'.
Catalog prints 'ANIMATN 218 Fundamentals of Animation (3' with a missing closing parenthesis; read as 3 units.

Catalog titles differ from the state file: ANIMATN 221 printed as 'Three-Dimensional Animation I' (state: Advanced Three-Dimensional Animation I); ANIMATN 227 printed as 'Three-Dimensional Animation Project' (state: Three-Dimensional Character Animation).
Asterisks on ANIMATN 212, 225 and 227 denote prerequisites, not alternate requirements.

The description also mentions entertainment, design, and communications industries and emerging fields (medical research, engineering, virtual and augmented reality, immersive media); these were read as industries/application areas rather than named careers and were not recorded as careers.
